snippet.title: Ale Abbey | 1.0 Release Date Announcement | TEASER
snippet.description:
Ale Abbey will release on the 17th of September!

After six months in Early Access, our monastery management, beer brewing, and monk-drinking tycoon game is receiving its final touches as we prepare for the 1.0 release. 

Buy now on Steam -  https://shiro.li/tMcqNe

#AleAbbey #ShiroGames #PixelArt #Tycoon #indiegames
